deterministic_fidelity.definition: Objective fidelity F: weighted geometric mean of attribute fidelities after constraints (MATHEMATICAL_SPECIFICATION §§5–7), recomputed by pipeline.engine.
deterministic_fidelity.range: [0,1]; null when a constraint fails or missing weight exceeds the limit

learned_similarity.definition: Similarity in a learned terrain-embedding space.
learned_similarity.reason: Stage 3; gate requires ≥50 distinct sites and ≥5000 patches; snapshot has 9 sites and no committed patch rasters

environmental_similarity.definition: Geometric mean of this objective's climate attribute fidelities (t_min_c, t_max_c, precip_mm), when the objective uses them and values exist.

geological_similarity.reason: No geology or mineralogy layers in the snapshot

operational_suitability.definition: All mission constraints of the objective pass (true), any fails (false), or a constraint value is missing (null).

novelty.definition: Unusualness relative to the Earth candidate population. Not similarity to the target.

data_completeness.definition: Share of the objective's attribute weight whose Earth and target values are both known.

ranking_stability.definition: Rank distribution under log-normal perturbation of attribute weights and match widths. Method sensitivity only; not measurement uncertainty or evidence strength.

ranking.order: descending deterministic_fidelity; ineligible candidates last with rank null; ties broken by aoi_id

physical_non_equivalence.alternative: Parabolic flight or gravity offload for the applicable task; terrestrial field gravity remains 1 g
Thermal vacuum or controlled pressure chamber
Thermal vacuum chamber with controlled thermal boundary conditions
Separate radiation qualification; terrestrial field ranking does not model radiation
Characterized material testing and suitable regolith simulants; no composition claim from DEM

limitations: Exploratory pilot: candidates are a small hand-selected set of regional windows, not a global sample.
Ranking reuses the provisional deterministic engine; weights and widths are not calibrated against independent field evidence (Stage 2 pre-registered evaluation not yet run).
Terrain similarity does not establish field suitability, access, safety or planetary equivalence.
Ranking stability reflects sensitivity to method parameters only, not DEM or land-cover measurement error.
Learned similarity, geology and novelty are not available in Stage 1.
